Item.Description:
A color photograph taken inside the Pullen Park Carousel house of 4 horses, 1 chariot, 1 pig, 2 rabbits, and 2 ostriches. From left to right: a yellow ear; the back half of a pig with green and pink red trim decorative harnesses and part of the brown seat; a brown horse with a black mane, white snout, and the white lower legs that has a brown seat and yellow trimmed green harness; a chariot with burgundy seats and brown and green decorative sides; a brown horse with a black mane that has a red and yellow trimmed green harness and a brown seat; a brown horse from the chest up with a black trimmed green harness and a brown seat; a white and light brown/gray horse with a black/brown mane and a red trimmed pink harness; a gray rabbit with a red trimmed pink harness; the ear of a brown rabbit; two blue and gray ostriches. The carousel house is screened in and a white man in a white shirt is visible.

Reverse is white with gold text reading "Kodak-Official Sponsor of the Olympic Games" with the Olympic rings and "Kodak Royal Paper." Black printed text reads "<No.15A>515 21+1 NNNNN+15AU 0141."

Title: Pullen Park Collection - PPC2022.005.043
